title: Rotation invariance of paired Gaussian vectors
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $t\in\mathbb R$. The planar rotation by $t$, applied coordinatewise to a pair of vectors in $\mathbb R^n$, preserves the product of two standard Gaussian measures on $\mathbb R^n$.
replaced: Let $n\ge0$, let $\gamma_n$ be standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$, and let $G,G\prime$ be independent vectors with law $\gamma_n$. For any real $t$, the map $(g,h)\mapsto(\cos t\,g+\sin t\,h,-\sin t\,g+\cos t\,h)$ preserves $\gamma_n\otimes\gamma_n$.
